title: 第15章 邪教徒第16章 最后一项
slug: 从衔尾蛇石碑开始超凡
lines: 林野看着颜仪，心头不由一愣，像是看到了前世的自己。
‘怪不得能养出这种坚韧的气质。’
他暗暗点头，结合那种矛盾的柔弱气质以及有家传武学的情况。
大概是传统习武家庭，只是家中不知出了什么变故，才不得不变得坚韧起来。
就是不知道上边还有没有挑大梁的了，如果没有，真不知道承受了多大的压力。
“好，你加油。”
说完，他看了一眼时间，18：12。
“那今天就到这吧，再晚坐不上公交车了。”他说。
颜仪听到林野的话语有些遗憾，忽的又抬起头。
“师兄，我有驾照，我送你吧？”
林野起身摆摆手，“不用了，我自己回去就行。”
说罢，他转身离开。
颜仪跟着走出单间，看着林野的背影有些欲言又止。
她的意思其实是可以多练一会的，不用担心坐不上车。
林野走出拳馆，天色已经暗了下来，远处微亮的晚霞渐渐被暗云掩藏。
唤出丰碑，看着解锁条件中的【完整流畅的打完整套《魄鲸拳》（未完成）】。
微微握紧拳头，感受着身体各处的劲感，露出笑容。
丰碑消失，他微微抬眸，目光渐渐变得锐利，像是找回了当初决定挑战尾崎八项时的感觉。
一阵沉闷的笛音从身后传来，他回头看向拳馆，一辆有着黑白条纹的车辆停在拳馆门前。
从车上下来几人，急匆匆地走进拳馆。
“警署司的人？”
林野面露几分疑惑，警署司的人来拳馆做什么？
想了想，他没有回去，径直离开。
晚间，林野坐在电脑桌前，把手中的盆栽放下。
竹子一样的主茎，顶端是一朵莲花模样的多肉，通体都是黑色，质感像是晒干后的油漆。
‘黑竹莲。’
本来就是顺路去花卉市场转了一下，没想到真有。
价格也不贵，连盆带花才三十块。
听花店老板说，这种黑竹莲花不算花，草不算草。
而且最重要的是也不好吃，所以在西洲那边都泛滥了，属于附赠品。
摆了摆黑竹莲的位置，他打开搜索引擎，输入‘金缕夜蝠’四个字。
content_en:
Lin Ye looked at Yan Yi and couldn't help but feel stunned, as if he had seen himself in his previous life.
‘No wonder I have developed such a tenacious temperament. ’
He nodded secretly, combining the contradictory weak temperament with the family's martial arts.
It was probably a traditional martial arts family, but something happened at home that forced them to become tougher.
I just don’t know if there are still people from above who are taking the lead. If not, I really don’t know how much pressure I have endured.
"Okay, come on."
After saying that, he looked at the time, 18:12.
"Then let's stop here today. If it's later, we won't be able to get on the bus," he said.
Yan Yi felt a little regretful when she heard Lin Ye's words, and suddenly raised her head again.
"Brother, I have a driver's license, shall I give it to you?"
Lin Ye stood up and waved his hand, "No, I can just go back by myself."
After that, he turned and left.
Yan Yi followed out of the single room and looked at Lin Ye's back, hesitant to speak.
What she actually meant was that she could practice a little longer without worrying about not being able to get in the car.
When Lin Ye walked out of the boxing gym, the sky had darkened, and the faint sunset in the distance was gradually hidden by dark clouds.
Call out the monument and look at the unlocking conditions [Complete and smooth complete set of "Soul Whale Fist" (unfinished)].
He clenched his fists slightly, feeling the strength in every part of his body, and smiled.
The monument disappeared, and he raised his eyes slightly, his eyes gradually becoming sharper, as if he had regained the feeling he had when he decided to challenge Ozaki's eight events.
"Du-du!"
A dull flute sound came from behind, and he turned back to look at the boxing gym. A vehicle with black and white stripes parked in front of the boxing gym.
Several people got out of the car and hurried into the boxing gym.
"Someone from the Police Department?"
Lin Ye looked a little confused. What were the people from the police station doing in the boxing gym?
After thinking about it, he didn't go back and just left.
...
In the evening, Lin Ye sat at his computer desk and put down the potted plant in his hand.
It has a bamboo-like main stem with a lotus-like fleshy stem at the top. The whole body is black and the texture is like dried paint.
‘Black Bamboo Lotus. ’
I originally just stopped by the flower market, but I didn't expect it to be there.
The price is not expensive, only 30 yuan including pots and flowers.
I heard from the flower shop owner that this kind of black bamboo lotus is not a flower, and grass is not a grass.
And the most important thing is that it is not delicious, so it is widely available in Xizhou, and it is a bonus.
After arranging the position of the black bamboo lotus, he opened the search engine and entered the words 'golden night bat'.
